lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The last of the hunters falls. By the time {mc} reaches the Stranger, she is cold.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: I never even learned your name.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her hand is still closed around the hilt, as if she meant to fight on.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Smoke drifts over {village}. Somewhere a dog will not stop barking.
